display_name: Thor six-axis physical robot arm — original hardware CAD
frozen_protocol_status: awaiting_parent_protocol_freeze; no conversion, repair or benchmark executed
selection_rationale: Public original physical robot hardware design with 49 discrete main STEP solids plus source FreeCAD assemblies and six documented rotary degrees of freedom. It requires articulation and physics authoring; no simulation description was removed to manufacture the starting state.

source.origin_class: Original manufacturer/maker mechanical CAD repository, not a simulation-description export

input_contract.neutral_geometry_form: 49 separate STEP AP214 manufacturing parts, each with one MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP; these are not a single preassembled STEP file.
input_contract.optional_mods: Original mods directory preserved as provenance; use of variants must be explicitly frozen before runs.
input_contract.preferred_frozen_variant: Unmodified main standard design, excluding optional mods from active composition.
input_contract.safe_preflight_boundary: Only browse, download, checksum, ZIP/XML inspection and STEP entity counting performed. CAD kernel load, geometry conversion, import repair, physics and task execution remain for Horde after protocol freeze.

structure.units_evidence: All 49 primary STEP files contain SI_UNIT(.MILLI.,.METRE.); doc/ThorDimensions.png labels millimetres.
structure.counts_caveat: XML objects, embedded BREP records, instance links and STEP files are different counts; they are not verified rigid-body or final assembled-solid counts. Body grouping must be authored and validated later.

source_basis: Original native assembly names and separate geometric parts
Original dimensions drawing and physical/CAD banner
mechanism.geometry_separability_evidence: 49 primary STEP files each contain a separate single manifold BREP solid. Source assembly preserves six linked subassemblies; wrist Art56 contains multiple separate link/gear/gripper objects. No whole robot single-mesh merge is supplied as the selected input.
mechanism.physical_dof_claim_status: Publisher documented, not independently verified by motion or solver in this curation.
mechanism.grouping_caveat: Art56 combines physical joints 5 and 6 in one CAD subassembly and uses coupled wrist transmission; its rigid moving groups and actuator-to-joint mapping must be resolved. No inferred joint definitions have been applied.
mechanism.gripper: Source gripper geometry is preserved; gripper action is optional and outside the proposed arm-pose acceptance gate.
mechanism.physical_claim_caveat: Height and payload are publisher specifications, not measurements or validated dynamics from this run.

dependency_audit.case_sensitive_horde_risk: 323 unique XLink records use filename casing that differs from the preserved filenames. Source files are unchanged. A derived repair, if protocol permits, must count against repair budget.
dependency_audit.nonresolving_object_risk: Two references in AssemblyArt3 target absent LCS_OptoDisk and LCS_Art4MotorHolder objects in Art3Body. The geometry file exists, but native assembly loading has not been verified.
dependency_audit.standalone_step_geometry: Each selected STEP part is internally self-contained according to STEP entity inspection; CAD-kernel validity has not been checked.
software_dependencies_for_future_native_: Assembly4 to interpret native CAD placement expressions; exact pinned runtime to be frozen on Horde

initial_simulation_readiness.reason: Original manufacturing CAD lacks a physics articulation, collision approximations, validated masses/inertias, authored drives and verified simulation behavior.
initial_simulation_readiness.other_project_integration: README links separate AngelLM/Thor-ROS repository. It was not used, downloaded or stripped for this asset.
initial_simulation_readiness.existing_metadata: Native CAD contains placement expressions, coordinate systems, geometric features and assembly references. Preserve these as legitimate original CAD metadata.
validation_performed: Archive extraction without unsafe paths or symlinks
SHA256 inventory for original archive and every extracted repository file
Read-only dependency path and object-name inspection
Visual inspection of publisher dimensions drawing and physical/CAD banner

proposed_physics_task.status: proposal only; parameters must be frozen before baseline execution
proposed_physics_task.name: Gravity-on articulated pose and reach
proposed_physics_task.setup: Fix the original base; preserve original geometric link shapes; author a six-revolute-joint rigid-body chain and documented body grouping. Establish units, limits, collision exclusions, inertial policy and drives before task execution.
sequence: Exercise each authored arm joint independently through a small safe-range excursion with other joints commanded to hold. Record measured joint positions, link transforms and unintended motion.
Reach a frozen set of five feasible end-effector position/orientation targets spanning shoulder/elbow and wrist motion. Targets must be independently established before comparing interventions.
Hold each target under gravity for a frozen duration and return to the home pose.
measurements: Number of independently controllable revolute joints (required at least five; expected six)
Source geometry preservation and dimension consistency
proposed_physics_task.thresholds: Not yet frozen; do not report a pass/fail for this proposal.
proposed_physics_task.out_of_scope: Physical hardware performance, certified payload, safety or learned-policy success.

ambiguities_and_risks: The neutral STEP files are individual parts; assembly placements come from original FreeCAD sources. A native importer is needed to recover assembly without manually inventing arrangement.
The native assembly contains path-case mismatches and two missing coordinate-system targets. These defects are retained and require measured remote preflight and, if permitted, bounded repair.
Six rotary DOF is supported by publisher documentation; independent geometric mobility and joint axes have not been validated.
The wrist differential couples motors for axes 5 and 6; do not confuse motor coordinates with independent joint coordinates.
The 2016 dimensions drawing is an original reference but may differ from later CAD; retain its date and verify actual imported bounds later.
Density, masses, inertias, damping, friction, joint limits and drive gains are unspecified for simulation. These are authoring decisions that must be documented and frozen.
Embedded FreeCAD license metadata differs from the explicit repository license; retain both records.
provenance_state: Original archive and all files preserved byte-for-byte. Only manifest/provenance audit files added. No simulation-ready model used.
